meta.name: Untamed 2025
meta.description:
In the vast expanse of Yosemite National Park, a woman's death draws a federal agent into lawless terrain — where nature obeys no rules but its own.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: A Celestial Event
videos.overview: When a woman fatally falls from El Capitan, special agent Kyle Turner suspects it wasn't an accident — and that the truth may lie deep within Yosemite.

videos.title: Jane Doe
videos.overview: The mystery around Jane Doe deepens as Turner and Vasquez investigate a strange symbol and visit a remote encampment in the woods.

videos.title: El-o'-win
videos.overview: Jane Doe's identity raises new questions about the life she left behind — and connects to an old case that has haunted Turner for years.

videos.title: Gold Rush
videos.overview: A grim discovery in the mines makes Turner question the squatters' role in the case. Vasquez fights to protect her son when his father reappears.

videos.title: Terces
videos.overview: Turner takes the investigation to new extremes — with serious repercussions. Jill gets caught up in Vasquez's conflict with her ex.

videos.title: All Trails Lead Here
videos.overview: As the investigation comes to a close, Turner discovers the truth about Lucy's death — and the long-buried secrets that set it in motion.
